Cedar Ridge College gives housing priority to seniors, first-year students, juniors, and sophomores. Non-degree students and graduate students are housed only if space remains after priority groups are placed.

Being on the housing waitlist does not automatically assign a room. When a room opens, Lakemont Institute texts the student, who has 24 hours to accept it online. Students who do not accept in time lose their waitlist place.

question: A student employee has 16 enrolled credits. Will this student’s application to keep an on-campus job be processed within three business days?
label: INSUFFICIENT_INFO

passages.text: Northvale University policy: a student employee must have at least 8 enrolled credits to keep an on-campus job.
Westbrook University guidance: Unpaid parking citations may result in a registration hold.
To stay eligible to compete, Westbrook University requires a term GPA of at least 2.00 and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.00.

question: A student on academic probation with 19 credits per term has asked for an exception. Will the office grant this particular request?
label: INSUFFICIENT_INFO

passages.text: Ashford College policy: a student on academic probation may have a maximum of 12 credits per term to register.
Silverlake University: Substituting a different course for a required major course requires approval from the department chair.
Harborview University policy: a graduate borrower may have at most 30 library items checked out at one time to borrow materials.

question: A student plans to use 4 independent study credits within the final 30 credits. Does that number fall within the policy?
label: YES

passages.text: At Ashford College, up to 20 independent study credits may count toward the major, but no more than 4 of the final 30 credits may be independent study credits.
Harborview University guidance: Dropping below half-time enrollment may affect a student’s scholarship eligibility.
Westbrook University allows a student employee to have at most 20 work hours per week in order to work on campus during the academic year.

question: Does the system allow enrollment in two courses whose times overlap without any approval?
label: NO

passages.text: Co-requisite courses must be added at the same time, or the system will not add them, and dropping one co-requisite drops both. The system also blocks enrollment when one course’s end time meets or overlaps another course’s start time.
A student may graduate with honors if they have a cumulative GPA of 3.50 or higher, complete a senior thesis, and have no academic integrity violations.

Undergraduates with 12 or more attempted credits (PSU and transfer combined) whose cumulative PSU GPA is below 2.00 are placed on academic warning. A registration hold stays in place until the student completes a required workshop run by Advising and Career Services.

question: Is an In-Progress (IP) grade included in the GPA?
label: NO

passages.text: Only A through F grades are included in PSU GPA calculations. W, X, M, IP, and I grades carry no grade points and are excluded from the GPA.
At Harborview University, up to 60 online credits may count toward a bachelor’s degree, but no more than 20 of the final 60 credits may be online credits.

Graduate students taking more than 16 credits in a term need approval: 17 to 19 credits require department head approval, and 20 or more credits require approval from the graduate committee chair and the dean of graduate studies.

question: Will this instructor add a particular waitlisted student to Canvas?
label: INSUFFICIENT_INFO

passages.text: Being added to a Canvas course by an instructor does not mean a student is registered. Waitlisted students receive view-only Canvas access during the first week of class, and full participation requires being registered.
At Silverlake University: An audited workshop counts toward certificate requirements.

Undergraduates who take more than 21 credits in a term need prior approval. For 22 to 25 credits, the academic program adviser must approve an Overload Approval Form before the term begins; for 26 or more credits, a petition to the Academic Requirements Committee is required.

question: According to Ashford College’s guidance, can withdrawing from all classes change on-campus housing eligibility?
label: YES

passages.text: Ashford College guidance: Withdrawing from all classes may change a student’s on-campus housing eligibility.
Ashford College allows a student on academic probation to have no more than 13 credits per term in order to register.
Pinecrest College policy: an undergraduate must have a cumulative GPA of at least 3.25 to stay in the honors program.

question: Is taking more than 12 credits while on probation allowed automatically, without any approval?
label: INSUFFICIENT_INFO

passages.text: Silverlake University: Substituting a different course for a required major course requires approval from the department chair.
Cedar Ridge College accepts a maximum of 24 internship credits toward a bachelor’s degree. Within the final 60 credits, at most 6 may be internship credits.
Lakemont Institute policy: a student employee must have 12 or more enrolled credits to keep an on-campus job.
